title: DPA-MoE: A Runtime Precision Control Framework for MoE Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.21378v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models reduce computation by routing each token to a small set of experts, but each selected expert is still used at a fixed precision. We present DPA-MoE, a runtime precision control framework that makes routed experts any-precision. DPA-MoE encodes expert feed-forward weights as prefix-decodable chunks using SharedScale AnyBCQ, profiles per-expert reconstruction residuals offline, and allocates chunks at inference time using live router gate scores. This post-routing allocation lets a single encoded MoE checkpoint operate at multiple effective weight budgets without retraining or re-encoding. Experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B and DeepSeekMoE-16B show that DPA-MoE improves KL divergence and downstream accuracy over uniform chunk allocation at matched budgets, with modest steady-state throughput overhead in our prototype.

translated_title: DPA-MoE：一种面向MoE推理的运行时精度控制框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.21378v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：混合专家模型通过将每个token路由到一小组专家来降低计算量，但每个被选中的专家仍然以固定精度运行。我们提出了DPA-MoE，这是一个使路由专家支持任意精度的运行时精度控制框架。DPA-MoE使用SharedScale AnyBCQ将专家前馈权重编码为前缀可解码的块，离线分析每个专家的重构残差，并在推理时根据实时路由器门控分数来分配这些块。这种路由后分配方式使得单个编码的MoE检查点能够在多个有效权重预算下运行，而无需重新训练或重新编码。在Qwen3-30B-A3B和DeepSeekMoE-16B上的实验表明，DPA-MoE在相同预算下比统一块分配方法提升了KL散度和下游准确率，且在我们的原型中仅带来适度的稳态吞吐量开销。
tldr: DPA-MoE提出了一种运行时精度控制框架，使MoE模型的路由专家支持任意精度，通过离线分析专家重构残差并结合实时路由门控分数动态分配权重块，让单个模型检查点无需重训练或重编码即可在多种权重预算下运行，并在匹配预算下取得优于统一块分配的精度表现。
en_tdlr: DPA-MoE is a runtime precision control framework that makes routed MoE experts any-precision by encoding weights as prefix-decodable chunks and dynamically allocating them based on live router gate scores, enabling a single encoded checkpoint to operate at multiple weight budgets without retraining or re-encoding.
